authorizationScope: Fresh anonymous public-browser cookie consent and refund/legal QA. No authentication, user-session access, provider configuration changes, or mocked analytics requests.

checks.name: No optional analytics requests, identifiers or analytics cookies before choice
Reject all persists through reload and keeps analytics off
Accept all permits real Blueprint analytics HTTP requests and survives navigation; persistence is recorded separately from response booleans
Withdrawal stops new optional requests and clears identifiers/cookies in the already-loaded document
Reopening preserves selected choices; withdrawal persists, stops analytics and clears optional identifiers/cookies
Mobile refund route is linked next to beta cost, renders prior-purchase terms/contact and has no horizontal overflow
Privacy exposes deletion settings, previous policy, refunds and working terms navigation

limitations: Observed requests cover these synthetic anonymous journeys only; this does not certify every Google Analytics Enhanced Measurement configuration or event.
No authenticated deletion was exercised by this script; root owns the separately authorized synthetic-account proof.
Only sanitized provider host/path classifications, statuses and marker booleans are retained; no credential values, request bodies, query strings, fragments, or cookie values are recorded.

markerProbe.assertion: Diagnostic observation only; no claim that remote Enhanced Measurement settings are comprehensively verified.

positiveControls.interpretation: Each provider is observed independently. Blueprint 202 responses do not establish GA/PostHog collection or durable Blueprint persistence.
